detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

5-Amino-1MQ

Chemical Information:
  • Chemical Name: 5-Amino-1-methylquinolinium
  • Molecular Formula: C₁₀H₁₁N₂⁺
  • Molecular Weight: ~159.21 g/mol
  • Compound Class: Small-molecule quinolinium derivative
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

5-Amino-1MQ is a synthetic small-molecule compound belonging to the quinolinium chemical class. Unlike peptides, this compound is not composed of amino acid chains and is produced via chemical synthesis rather than peptide assembly.

Supplied as a solid material, 5-Amino-1MQ is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research and is designed for use by qualified professionals conducting analytical or mechanistic studies involving small-molecule compounds.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of small-molecule interactions in enzymatic or biochemical assay systems
  • Laboratory studies examining structure–activity relationships of quinolinium derivatives
  • Analytical method development for non-peptide research compounds
  • Comparative studies involving small-molecule analogs in controlled experimental environments
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: White to off-white crystalline powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in water and polar organic solvents
Compliance Notice:

5-Amino-1MQ is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
